title: 航空宇宙工学概論
subtitle: Introduction to Aerospace Engineering
teachers:
AKASAKA Takeshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn all the engineering (aerospace, structure, equipment, control) needed
to conduct research, development, design and manufacture of aircraft
(2) learn the relationships among the fields of professional engineering
(3) learn about aircraft design and manufacturing processes
advice:
This is a basic introduction to aircraft design course. We will cover the following materials:

1. Atmosphere
2. Types of aircraft, such as Fixed wing and Rotorcraft, and spacecraft
3. Lift and Drag
4. Jet Engines
5. Stability and Control
6. Structure, Materials and Structural Design
7. Rocket and Spacecraft
8. Drone and Electric aircraft
9. Aircraft Design Process

Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to solve the exercises on their own.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedule of quizzes,
tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from the class, as they may miss handouts.
books: Introduction to Aeronautics, Second edition (in Japanese), Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge:
Completed the courses in Industrial Mechanics and Mechanical Mechanics.
Basic knowledge of mechanics (kinematics and moment of force).

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the role of aircraft and spacecraft components.
Be able to understand the basic content of the aeronautics (aerodynamics, structure, equipment, control).
Be able to describe performance using numerical values such as aircraft weight and center of gravity.
Be able to understand and explain aircraft development, design and manufacturing processes.
